name: druineach

attributes.attribute: Scottish folkloric spirit rarely seen by humans
beats the ground in spring to bring first green growth

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The druineach is a Scottish folkloric spirit. This Highland being rarely appears to humans. The druineach emerges each spring. The spirit beats upon the ground with force. That beating brings forth the first green growth. Folklore casts the druineach as a bringer of life. Its work marks the turn from winter to growth. Shepherds and farmers honored the spirit’s visit. They saw it as a promise of plenty for the land.
